integrity: Analytical derivation independently reconstructs the singular limit from specified published finite-exponent identities; auxiliary quadrature is not used as an infinite proof. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Each fixed dimension at least three; mixed radial-angular norm only; the critical endpoint is unbounded; the leading constant is an explicit convergent improper integral rather than an elementary constant. The sharpness and cell-positivity lemmas in the cited source are used as published premises.
title: Universal critical power law for sharp mixed spherical Fourier-extension stability
